quickExit.label: Quick exit
quickExit.hint: You can also press the Esc key two times fast to leave.

resources.heading: Free help from an advocate
resources.intro: Advocates help people who are asking for a protection order. They can talk with you about your options. Their help is free and private.
resources.none: Contacts for advocates are being added. Please check back soon.

timeout.heading: Are you still here?
timeout.body: To protect your privacy, everything you typed will be cleared in {seconds} seconds.

start.heading: Get your story ready to file
start.intro: This tool helps you organize what happened before you fill out the court's online form for a protection order. It asks the kind of questions court staff ask when they help people in person.
start.notFiling: This tool does not file anything for you. It does not give legal advice.
start.safetyNote: If someone else uses this device, they may see what you type. Nothing is saved. To leave fast, use Quick exit at the top of the screen. Everything is cleared after {minutes} minutes with no activity.
start.caseTypeLegend: What kind of protection order are you asking for?
start.caseTypeHint: If you are not sure, pick "Not sure." You can still finish.

story.heading: Tell what happened
story.intro: Write what happened in your own words. Include each time something happened, even if it seems small. If you remember about when it happened, include that too.
story.label: What happened
story.hint: Try starting a new paragraph for each time something happened. That makes it easier to split your story into incidents.
story.sampleNote: Demo only. These buttons do not appear in the real tool.
story.redoWarning: If you organize your story again, the new list will replace your current list of incidents.

organize.heading: Check your incidents
organize.intro: An incident is one time something happened. We split your story into incidents. Check each one. You can edit, merge, delete, or add incidents.
organize.draftNote: This list is a draft. Nothing is final until you say it looks right.
organize.empty: There are no incidents yet. You can add one below.

incident.heading: Incident {n}
incident.approximateHint: For example: early March, or the week before Thanksgiving.
incident.evidenceHint: For example: screenshots, photos, or people who saw it.
incident.reorderHint: Use Move up and Move down to change the order of incidents. On a computer, you can also drag.

check.heading: A few questions
check.intro: Court staff often ask questions like these when they help someone fill out the form. For each one, you can add more or continue as is. It is your choice.

review.heading: Review your incidents
review.notFiling: This tool does not file your petition. To file, copy this summary into the court's online form, or print it.
review.order: Incidents with an exact date are listed first, from oldest to newest. Incidents without an exact date come after, in the order you gave them.
review.copyFailed: Could not copy. You can select the summary and copy it yourself.
review.clipboardNote: Copied text stays on this device until you copy something else. If others use this device, you may want to copy something else when you are done.
review.clearQuestion: Clear everything you typed and start over?

badges.heading: Questions that may come up
badges.summary: {count} questions may come up in the next step. You can add detail now or answer them later.
badges.summaryNone: No questions are expected for this list.

timeline.heading: Timeline
timeline.empty: Incidents will show here once you add them.

announce.organized: We made {count} incidents from your story.
announce.added: Added a new incident. You now have {count}.
announce.deleted: Incident deleted. You now have {count}. Undo is available for a few seconds.
announce.merged: Incidents merged. You now have {count}. Undo is available for a few seconds.
announce.undone: Done. Your change was undone. You now have {count}.
